einzeiler: 学习职场和商务英语中关于付款与转账的常用英语表达。
kurzfassung: 本期节目聚焦商务英语中的付款与转账场景。节目详细讲解了付尾款、安排付款和转账等常用搭配。通过实际例句帮助听众掌握外贸商务交流中的核心表达。
stichpunkte: 学习付尾款的专业表达：Settle the balance
掌握安排付款的常用搭配：arrange payment
学习转账的表达方式：transfer funds
掌握付款的多种说法：make the payment
学习发送付款的句型：send the payment
学习结清账款的表达：settle the payment

kapitel.titel: 付款与转账常用英语表达

beschreibung:
付款/转账
1. Settle the balance(付余款，付尾款)
l Could you please settle the balance of the invoice at your earliest convenience?
2. Arrange the payment(安排付款，准备付款)
l We will await the funds to come back into the account and arrange the payment.
3. Transfer funds（转钱）
l Unfortunately, we can’t transfer funds until we receive the transaction back into our account.
l The other option is to transfer the funds directly to our bank account.
4. Make the payment（付款）
l I have made the payment today and it should clear their account in the next few days.
5. Send the payment（付款）
l I have sent payment to both vendors.
6. Settle the payment（付款）
l You have already settled the payment of this order.
